content.short: Mu Digital tokenizes Asian fixed-income credit, letting stablecoin holders earn bond-backed yield.
content.description: Mu Digital tokenizes Asian fixed income, structuring government bonds, corporate bonds and private credit into two on-chain tokens. AZND, the Asia Dollar, is the senior tranche backed by those credit assets, while muBOND is a junior tranche designed to absorb portfolio-level volatility. Splitting the exposure this way lets conservative allocators hold the senior claim while others take the first loss for a higher return, and the protocol operates on Monad.
content.meta: Asian credit markets brought onchain, backed by investment-grade bonds and private credit.
